d: How does China’s vast intelligence network operate, and why has the alleged use of romantic relationships as an espionage tactic returned to the spotlight? From the CIA infiltration claims surrounding Nixon’s historic 1972 China visit to the secretive Ministry of State Security (MSS), the People’s Liberation Army’s intelligence units and the United Front Work Department, we uncover Beijing’s alleged spy network. We also examine honey traps, long-term recruitment strategies, economic espionage and the controversy surrounding former NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang. Inside China’s world of espionage,…
